name: devfoundry
description: devFoundry: Claude Code plugins for MuleSoft and API engineering: integration and resilience patterns, API contracts, Mule engineering rules and project profiles.

plugins.name: api-first
plugins.description: API-first implementation: what exists reused first, requirements inventoried and numbered, contract before code, tests traced to each requirement, and a final check that no requirement was silently left out.

plugins.name: integration-patterns
plugins.description: Decides whether an integration flow needs an Enterprise Integration Pattern (Hohpe and Woolf catalog, starting with the Idempotent Receiver) and applies it only when its problem is present, with verified Mule 4 realizations.

plugins.name: resilience-patterns
plugins.description: Decides whether code that calls another system needs a resilience pattern (Circuit Breaker, session renewal, a bounded fan-out with a time budget, retry of transient failures) against a slow or failing dependency, with verified Mule 4 realizations.

plugins.name: engineering-profile
plugins.description: Applies the project's engineering/profile.yaml and the rules packs it extends (naming, precedence over legacy code, rules overridden or added by ID, floor rules), and makes each Mule 4 flow's integration decisions explicit before writing code.

plugins.name: api-contracts
plugins.description: Makes every REST endpoint start from a spec that describes it, writing or extending the spec in the project when the published one lacks it, with rules for OpenAPI 3 and RAML contracts, the API-led layer an API belongs to and the limits its contract states.

plugins.name: mule-engineering
plugins.description: Mule 4 engineering rules with verified examples: flows, properties, the global error handler, logs and the build; DataWeave; the APIkit router and the spec it loads; MUnit tests that call each endpoint through the HTTP listener.
